verdict.rationale: Lago is clearly API-first. It publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 schema (probe-confirmed), every endpoint has a generated command, and the docs say usage charges can be updated 'via API or Lago's no-code UI.' One community user also calls the API well-designed. However, nothing explicitly claims full UI-to-API parity, and several guides (e.g. assigning a plan) are written as UI click-paths with no stated API equivalent. missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity guarantee, API coverage evidence for UI-only flows such as plan assignment, dashboards and filters, and hands-on independent confirmation of parity.
